title: VLAN Segmentation and Access Port Configuration
summary: Create multiple Virtual LANs (VLANs) on a Cisco Catalyst switch, assign static access ports, and demonstrate Layer 2 broadcast domain isolation between departmental subnets.
learning_objectives: Explain the purpose of VLANs in segmenting broadcast domains and improving network security
Create and name VLANs in Cisco IOS Global Configuration mode
Assign physical switch interfaces to specific VLANs using access mode
Use interface range syntax for bulk port configuration
Verify VLAN assignments and port operational states using show vlan brief and show interfaces switchport
Demonstrate Layer 2 traffic isolation between devices in different VLANs on the same physical switch

source.origin: Independently authored switching curriculum guide based on IEEE 802.1Q standards and Cisco IOS configuration documentation
